recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as the core reconciliation for FHIR-55973. No further core source change is needed for this issue beyond the normal publication/build process that regenerates rendered artifacts from these StructureDefinition inputs.
issue_request: FHIR-55973 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core Questionnaire. It asked whether repeats=true questions with answer lists may select the same item more than once, and the approved resolution required a QuestionnaireResponse.item invariant prohibiting duplicate answers plus Questionnaire.item.repeats wording that says repeated question answers are distinct.
initial_application: The Jira comment links HL7/fhir#4074, whose implementation branch contains commit b1e5d1f775d02656aedbe16c20db828f10d629be adding the distinct-answer wording and qrs-4 invariant. That pull request remains open and the current build-scope source on this branch still had the older multiple-answers wording and no duplicate-answer invariant, so the applied issue was not yet represented in the current source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse as active resources, so the edited StructureDefinition source files feed the current build. The originating Zulip thread records the UI/modeling concern and Lloyd McKenzie's statement that duplicate selections should not be supported. FHIR SDC minutes for 2026-02-26 record FHIR-55973 as Persuasive. FHIR-55921 and FHIR-55975 appeared on the same minutes page only; they are separate Resolved - change required issues and were not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml so Questionnaire.item.repeats describes multiple distinct answers and leads with the group/question representation rule. Changed source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml to add qrs-4 on QuestionnaireResponse.item with answer.value.isDistinct().allTrue(), and added qrs-4 as a condition on QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.
source_changes: source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml: updated Questionnaire.item.repeats definition/comment to say repeated question answers are multiple distinct answers and to put the group/question representation note first.

source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: added qrs-4 invariant requiring answer.value.isDistinct().allTrue() and referenced it from QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.
